notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1.0 - Bee Hives 🐝, Bug Fix & Balance
notes.content:
🛠 Hexaroma – June 7 Update 🐝

A sweet little patch just landed! Balanced, cozy, and buzzing with life 🧡

🔧 Adjustments and fixes made on the data side — things should feel smoother now.
🏡 New placeable building added — we’ve moo-ved on from cows to bees this time! 🍯

→ Harvest Festival 🌽
→ Community Feast 🥘

Small details, big vibes. Happy building! 🌸

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.1 - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
Hey Dear Villagers!

[h3]🛠️ Fixes & Improvements[/h3]
[b]Tutorial Flow Fix[/b]:  
  - Previously, if you exited and returned before finishing the tutorial, it resumed correctly.  
  - However, starting a [b]New Game[/b] mid-tutorial also resumed progress instead of resetting.  
  - This is now fixed! When restarting, the tutorial properly resets to step 0.  
  - Also cleaned up tutorial step subscriptions for better stability.

[b]UI Polish & Quality of Life[/b]:  
  - Improved [b]Credits UI[/b] for a smoother experience.  
  - Added a [b]Complete Button[/b] for auto-tutorial steps based on player feedback—prevents skipping crucial instructions too fast.

✅ Tested thoroughly across various scenarios, including restarting, saving, and reloading. Everything should now function as intended!  

🆙 Update is live!

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: HEXAROMA: Village Builder is now Available! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey Villagers!

HEXAROMA: Village Builder is officially live on Steam! Step into a cozy yet strategic world where you’ll build your own tiny island village and guide your Hexling settlers to prosperity. 🌿🏡

[h3]🔷 Relaxing Yet Engaging Gameplay[/h3]
HEXAROMA blends relaxing city-building with smart puzzle mechanics. Place buildings strategically, optimize your layout, and expand your thriving village across hexagonal islands. Whether you enjoy a peaceful creative session or prefer chasing high scores, there’s something for everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137422/14a9bba142290cfa6d404d212856542e8ec98ac0.jpg[/img]

[h3]🏡 Key Features:[/h3]
✔ Charming Village Building – Design your island settlements and watch them flourish.
✔ Hexagonal Strategy – Plan your placements carefully to maximize efficiency and growth.
✔ Multiple Biomes – Build in lush forests, scorching deserts, snowy tundras, and more!
✔ Progression & Unlocks – Earn new building packs and unlock bigger maps as you play.
✔ Dynamic Weather & Day-Night Cycle – Make your village feel alive.
✔ Online Leaderboards – Compete against friends and players worldwide for the best scores!
✔ Full Controller Support – Play comfortably on PC or Steam Deck.
✔ Achievements & Steam Cloud – Save your progress and show off your milestones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45137422/fd1d9438a2a249bdbfc95c0e4db40ca01a70ea1e.png[/img]

[h3]🎉 Limited-Time Launch Discount![/h3]
To celebrate the release, HEXAROMA is[b] available at 20% OFF[/b] until March 25! Don’t miss out—grab your copy and start building today!

Join the HEXAROMA community, share your best village designs, and see how high you can climb on the leaderboards.

👉 Get HEXAROMA Now on Steam

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3056580/HEXAROMA/

Happy building, and see you in the Hexling colonies! 🏡✨
